classification.difficultyReason: Select the appropriate quantity-per-unit relationship and link unit-rate calculations with conversions such as hours to minutes or days to weeks.

children.label: a
children.prompt: A guesthouse has used 630 L of milk over a 30-day period. At what rate, in litres per week, is it using milk?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Milk used per day}&=630\div30\\\text{Milk used per day}&=21\text{ L/day}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Milk used per week}&=21\times7\\\text{Milk used per week}&=147\text{ L/week}\end{align*}$$

children.label: b
children.prompt: A firm pays its workers $\$1800$ per 40-hour week. What rate of pay is this in dollars per minute?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Pay per hour}&=1800\div40\\\text{Pay per hour}&=\$45/\text{h}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Pay per minute}&=45\div60\\\text{Pay per minute}&=\$0.75/\text{min}\end{align*}$$

children.label: c
children.prompt: 350 megalitres of water has flowed into a dam in two and a half days. What is the average flow rate, in megalitres per day?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Water flowing per day}&=350\div2.5\\\text{Water flowing per day}&=140\text{ ML/day}\end{align*}$$

children.label: d
children.prompt: A car has travelled 240 km on 48 L of petrol. At what rate, in litres per 100 km, is the car using petrol?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Petrol used per kilometre}&=48\div240\\\text{Petrol used per kilometre}&=\frac15\text{ L/km}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Petrol used per }100\text{ km}&=\frac15\times100\\\text{Petrol used per }100\text{ km}&=20\text{ L}\end{align*}$$

children.label: e
children.prompt: A log of wood weighs 3 kg and has a volume of $2400\text{ cm}^3$. What is its density, in kilograms per $\text{cm}^3$?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Mass per cubic centimetre}&=\frac{3}{2400}\\\text{Mass per cubic centimetre}&=\frac{1}{800}\text{ kg/cm}^3\end{align*}$$

children.label: f
children.prompt: A woman has been paid $\$3800$ for 250 hours of work. At what weekly rate is she being paid, assuming there are 40 hours in a normal working week?

answer.worked:
$$\begin{align*}\text{Pay per hour}&=3800\div250\\\text{Pay per hour}&=\$15.20/\text{h}\end{align*}$$
$$\begin{align*}\text{Pay per week}&=15.20\times40\\\text{Pay per week}&=\$608/\text{week}\end{align*}$$

children.label: g
children.prompt: A battered old truck has driven the 740 km from Wagga Wagga to Wee Waa in $18\frac12$ hours. What was its average speed, in kilometres per hour?

answer.worked: $$\begin{align*}\text{Distance travelled per hour}&=740\div18.5\\\text{Distance travelled per hour}&=40\text{ km/h}\end{align*}$$
